title: Artifact: Solvability-Driven Inference of Shadow Infrastructure
description: Redacted reproduction artifact for the manuscript submitted to IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management. Contains the four-state verdict engine, pre-registered grading truths, nine redacted testbed and three-machine scenarios, derived RIPE Atlas judgment summaries, figure audit readings, the full formalization behind the two headline properties, and a one-command check of every reported number. All public IPv4 addresses, credentials, host names, third-party product documentation and raw RIPE Atlas results are removed; private lab addresses are kept only because the topology scripts require them. Data and documentation are CC BY 4.0; code is MIT (see LICENSE).
